For those who don't follow stock markets, I wanted to share some evidence from the tickers that suggests big money is counting on remain. The two strongest indicators of how the UK will vote are pound/usd and gold. If remain wins, the pound will gain in terms of usd. The pound has been trading up for the past week (see http://www.xe.com/currencycharts/?from=GBP&to=USD&view=1W)) suggesting some confidence that UK will remain. Gold, on the other hand, is good at tracing fear and uncertainty in the market. If UK votes to leave, gold will trade sharply higher because of the uncertainty of the Europe. The weekly gold chart looks like the inverse of the pound/usd chart, moving lower and lower.

Based on these two important indicators it seems highly likely we'll get a remain vote. If you want to know the result of the vote before 12am est, check the forex markets. Many UK banks are holding private exit polling, and will be trading on it.
